sources.enabled: Draw a tee under a ball that rests above the ground. Visual only: the tee is a render object with no collision and no mass, drawn where the ball geometry is drawn, and it stays standing when the ball leaves.
sources.min_gap_m: Smallest height of the underside of the ball above the ground that gets a tee. 0.01 m is a display judgement: below it the ball reads as lying on the turf. A driver ball is teed up to 0.1016 m (ball_strike_settings.json), so it always passes.
sources.shaft_radius_m: Radius of the peg. 0.0025 m is a 5 mm peg, the order of a standard wooden tee shaft; a display size, not a measurement.
sources.cup_radius_m: Radius of the flat cup that carries the ball. 0.011 m is a display size, about half the ball radius; it must be smaller than the ball radius so the rim of the cup touches the ball.
sources.cup_height_m: Height of the cup (the wider top of the tee). 0.006 m is a display size; it is cut to the tee height when the ball is low.
